implemented_route: apps/cli -> Core::run -> input::structured_intent -> Intent::JsonStatistics -> ports::json_pointer_statistics -> math::summarize
supported_behavior_from_source: The custom JSON parser retains numeric values as a distinct node kind and rejects duplicate keys across the complete document.
One JSON Pointer must select an array containing 1..4096 JSON number literals; strings, null, booleans, objects and nested arrays return typed suspension errors.
Statistics retain exact JSON number lexemes without binary floating point conversion.
The report contains the full document digest, selected array span, each numeric source span and exact descriptive statistics; Core persists the report artifact and returns its digest dependency.
Report output is checked against the request evidence-byte budget before artifact storage.
